name: ARCTURUS DEFENSE Warbrace Mk9 Combat Arm
product_name: Arcturus Defense Solutions Warbrace Mk9 Combat Arm
description:
The Warbrace Mk9 is a full-replacement military combat arm built around a titanium-alloy endoskeleton with dual hydraulic actuator rails running the length of the forearm. Integrated into the dorsal forearm is a collapsible monofilament blade housing rated for 40,000 deployment cycles, while the knuckle plate is reinforced with impact-dispersal ceramics capable of absorbing repeated vehicle-grade strikes. The elbow joint houses a recoil dampening gyro that neutralizes up to 80% of heavy-firearm kickback when the arm braces a weapon.

The Mk9 is strictly restricted to licensed military contractors, active Meridian Enforcement Division personnel, and tier 4-5 private security firms with defense clearances. On the black market it commands a significant premium, and a Warbrace on a civilian arm is an immediate red flag to any street-level enforcer. Veterans who mustered out with one still attached often find the legality question follows them everywhere.
installation_requirements: Full shoulder disarticulation surgery, certified military-grade cyberneural surgeon, 72-hour inpatient recovery minimum
rejection_risk: Moderate — titanium chassis lacks biocompatible coating; neural interface requires calibrated pain-suppression during bonding
maintenance: Quarterly hydraulic fluid flush, blade housing lubrication, ceramic knuckle plate inspection; Arcturus-certified techs only

cultural_context: The Mk9 is synonymous with Meridian's privatized military class — a symbol of sanctioned violence that civilians recognize and fear on sight. Street gangs call anyone wearing one a 'wardog,' and the term carries equal parts respect and warning.
known_users: Meridian Enforcement Division special response units
story_hooks: A Mk9 turns up on a civilian dockworker — either stolen, black-market, or the worker isn't who they claim to be
An Arcturus Defense recall notice goes out for a specific Mk9 serial range citing 'blade deployment malfunction' — but the real reason is classified
A retired MED officer refuses to surrender their Mk9 post-discharge; Arcturus sends a retrieval team
